text: IMF staff assess risks to the EFF and RSF as moderate, the EFF as fully financed, and Seychelles' capacity to repay the Fund as adequate but subject to risks. Upon approval of the third reviews, SDR 6.107 million under the EFF and SDR 3.123 million under the RSF will be used for budget support. Six new structural benchmarks and revised targets are proposed for 2025, including raising June 2025 net international reserves to $628.8 million. Fund exposure will remain high for an extended period.
